description: Hand-labeled DEV-split fixtures pinning the AI explainer's per-choice behavior. Each item asserts the expected error mode for a specific chosen distractor (derived from questions.json choice_diagnosis, the human-authored ground truth) plus a token the feedback MUST mention. Used by ai_eval_explanations.py to catch regressions. DEV-ONLY: none of these ids may appear in the held_out split (enforced by the leakage check) so the held_out eval stays clean.

items.note: isocitrate->a-ketoglutarate distractor encodes a substrate-level-phosphorylation misconception
null-tagged non-diagnostic distractor -> honest near-miss, do not over-diagnose
same question, choice B -> content_gap (reverses anode/cathode)
same question, choice C -> execution trap (inverse): MUST differ from choice B feedback
same question, choice D -> execution trap (negation): MUST differ from B and C
used n=1 instead of n=2 electrons
CARS passage question -> passage-mapping feedback (no science choice_diagnosis)
